name: Lelet
headline: The launch test is running. Still below the stop line.

labels.testers: Devices that ran a first test
labels.letters: Devices that marked a letter as sent

needsMe.title: Keep your own devices out of the count
needsMe.detail: Done on the laptop on 14 Nov (Edge and Chrome). The phone is left: open the link once in the phone's browser.

needsMe.title: Send the 30 invitations, one by one
needsMe.detail: Sat 28 Nov at 10:00. The text is written; each link opens the app with the message ready. A script on your PC does the e-mail part: that morning it mails you a preview, and it sends to the people in your contact list only after you press Approve on the ReachPilot card. The contact list is still empty, so today it would send nothing. WhatsApp and Telegram stay one tap per person, because no tool may send from your account.

needsMe.title: Ask YLKI to read the letters
needsMe.detail: Sent on 14 Nov 2026 at 17:24 WIB to YLKI's consumer address, from Juwen's Gmail, with the review page attached as a PDF and five questions. No answer yet. On 16 Nov the page was made easier to answer (choices per question, the right to decline, the six places most likely to be wrong, what happens with an answer); the three letters and the question numbers are the same as in the PDF. Sending the request is not a legal review: the letters stay unchanged until a qualified person answers.

needsMe.title: Read YLKI's answer and decide what changes
needsMe.detail: A script on your PC runs every hour. It cannot read the inbox yet: the mail script in your Google account needs its new version first (about 2 minutes, the ReachPilot card has the button). After that it looks for YLKI's answer by itself, saves it on the PC only, and shows it on the card. If nothing has come by Tue 24 Nov it sends one reminder with the same PDF, and no second one; on Thu 3 Dec it closes the request as unanswered. Deciding what changes in the letters stays with you. Until then the launch test runs with the 'not legal advice' line.

needsMe.title: Second reader if YLKI stays silent: BPKN, a legal-aid clinic or a paid lawyer
needsMe.detail: BPKN's portal asks for the sender's identity, and a lawyer costs money, so neither was done for you. The same PDF and the same five questions can be reused as they are.

needsMe.title: Trademark search for the name Lelet
needsMe.detail: Tried on 14 Nov: the official search (PDKI) answered 403 to an automated browser and WIPO asked for a captcha. Not bypassed, so the result is unknown. Both open in a normal browser: look at class 9 and class 42. Not needed for the launch test.

needsMe.title: Third screen language: Chinese
needsMe.detail: The app now has Indonesian, English and Simplified Chinese screens. The letters stay in Indonesian in every language, because they go to Indonesian providers and to Komdigi. Checked by 56 unit tests and 94 browser checks. No native speaker has proofread the Chinese text.
